note: Structural rules always run. Named checks run as commands or built-in audits. A check that cannot run is not a pass: the submitter must skip it explicitly with a recorded reason and the Studio Director sees the skip at review.

typecheck.description: The project compiles under its own typecheck.

smoke.description: The project's smoke script passes against the current build.

assets.description: Every catalogue asset referenced has a verified commercial licence.

perf.description: Every declared platform profile has a recorded measurement meeting its budget.

profiling.description: At least one measurement exists per declared profile, recorded with device and method.

licencePolicy.note: CC BY-SA and any non-commercial or no-derivatives licence is excluded, matching the existing asset bank policy in this repository.

rejectOn: missing evidence for a production deliverable
